cursor.frontmatter:
name: commit-message
description: >-
  Writes one English commit subject from the relevant part of the
  conversation, in the form type(module): description. Types are feat, fix,
  refactor, opt, perf, docs, style, or chore, or a type the user already
  used in the conversation. Use when the user names commit-message or asks
  for that commit line. Does not read the workspace or diff to draft it.
disable-model-invocation: true
